breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the dynamic amplification from a suddenly applied load; for a linear elastic bar, the peak stress is not the same as the static stress.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated 'take the peak stress to be the same as the static stress P/A,' which ignores the dynamic amplification factor of 2 for a suddenly applied load. The generated specification removes this incorrect instruction entirely, matching the ground truth prompt which simply asks to determine the maximum stress using energy methods by comparing work done to strain energy stored. The generated specification correctly frames the problem as finding the maximum stress via energy methods without pre-emptively (and incorrectly) equating it to the static stress.
